target_customer: Patients with exhausted options, recurrence risk or undiagnosed conditions, and their clinicians
problem: Patients with complex oncology, rare or undiagnosed disease get little individualized research support; Omanta runs a patient-specific research program for each case.
business_model: Paid per-patient research service with clinician collaboration
product_category: Personalized patient research and multiomic analysis

founders.name: Alfredo Gonzalez
founders.background_notes: YC page says over 10 years in personalized medicine; worked on the Cancer Dependency Map.

founders.name: Ranad Humeidi
founders.background_notes: YC page cites a Harvard discovery that became a GSK collaboration.

competitors.name: First Ascent Biomedical
competitors.what: Drug testing, sequencing and AI mapping of tumor weaknesses for individual cancer patients

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires tissue logistics, multiomic profiling, a reference cohort and PhD scientific teams per case; heavy lab and data operations for a six person team.

defensibility.rationale: A growing internal reference cohort and scientist talent help, but the service is labor intensive and clinicians can buy from others.

market_need_then: The company frames demand around patients who have exhausted standard options; no independent demand data found.

identity.visual_style: Stylized cell illustrations with burgundy nucleus and blue cell cluster
identity.voice_and_tone: Clean and scientific; tagline A research lab For One

branding.brand_signature: Tagline A research lab For One

brand_strength.rationale: Coherent scientific identity on the site but no press about the brand itself found.

outcome_analysis: Omanta is a Summer 2026 YC company with no outcome yet. Founders with deep translational research credentials fit the domain, but per-patient research is operationally heavy and no funding or traction data is public.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125k seed; this matches the YC standard deal and has no company or press confirmation, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Product described by site; the website did not name founders, names come from the YC page.
